old_steps: The power button of the BactoSense is located on the right hand-side of the instrument.
*Figure 8-1 Power button of the BactoSense*

**Switching on** To switch the BactoSense on, shortly press on the power button. The power button LED  lights up constantly and after a few seconds, the welcome screen is displayed on the user  interface.

**Switching off** If you are logged in and want to switch the BactoSense off, tap on the logout button on the  top right corner of the user interface and select *Power off*. If you want to switch off from  the login page itself, press the power button for 10 seconds.

old_steps: **Einschalten** Drücken Sie kurz auf den Einschaltknopf, um den BactoSense einzuschalten. Die LED im Einschaltknopf leuchtet dauerhaft. Nach einigen Sekunden erscheint die Begrüßungsseite der Benutzeroberfläche.

**Ausschalten** Wenn Sie angemeldet sind und den BactoSense ausschalten möchten, tippen Sie oben rechts in der Benutzeroberfläche auf die Abmeldetaste und wählen Sie *Power off (Ausschalten)*. Wenn Sie das Gerät direkt von der Anmeldeseite aus ausschalten möchten, halten Sie den Einschaltknopf 10 Sekunden lang gedrückt.

| 2. | Press on Users and then select the user profile you want to edit. Press Edit after selecting one check box. | Admin users are allowed to change passwords from other user profiles. |
| 3. | Press on Change PIN, enter the new pin twice and press Save. |  |

old_steps: | 1. | On the Home screen, press Settings to open the settings menu. | ![BactoSense — Home button](/img/gui/icons/home-button.png "width=48 class=manual-icon") |
| 2. | Press the Maintenance button. | ![BactoSense — Maintenance menu](/img/gui/icons/maintenance-button.png "width=48 class=manual-icon") |
| 3. | Press the Special export import button. | ![BactoSense — Special export and import options](/img/gui/icons/special-import-export-button.png "width=48 class=manual-icon") |

| 4. | Connect a USB drive. If needed, press the Refresh USB list button until the drive is detected. | Make sure the *.bnv file is at the root of the USB drive. The USB drive should be formatted in FAT32, which is the common standard. |
| 5. | Press Import settings | ![BactoSense — USB import and export](/img/gui/en/usb-import-and-export.png "width=263") |

| 6. | Select the settings you want to import. Measurement settings include gate sets, IO settings, alarms, and date and time settings. Network settings include IP, DNS, and NTP addresses | ![BactoSense — Import settings options](/img/gui/en/import-settings-options.png "width=269") |
| 7. | Press Import settings and wait until the device reboots |  |

| 4. | Connect a USB drive. If needed, press the Refresh USB list button until the drive is detected. | Make sure the *.bnv file is at the root of the USB drive. The USB drive should be formatted in FAT32, which is the common standard. |
| 5. | Press the Import settings button. | ![BactoSense — USB import and export](/img/gui/en/usb-import-and-export.png "width=263") |

| 6. | Select the settings you want to import. Measurement settings include gate sets, IO settings, alarms, and date and time settings. Network settings include IP, DNS, and NTP addresses | ![BactoSense — Import settings options](/img/gui/en/import-settings-options.png "width=269") |
| 7. | Press Import settings, then Reboot now in the confirmation message, and wait until the device reboots. |  |

| 2. | Premere il pulsante Maintenance. | ![BactoSense — Menu di manutenzione](/img/gui/icons/maintenance-button.png "width=48 class=manual-icon") |
| 3. | Premere il pulsante Special export import. | ![BactoSense — Opzioni speciali di esportazione e importazione](/img/gui/icons/special-import-export-button.png "width=48 class=manual-icon") |

| 4. | Collegare un’unità USB. Se necessario, premere Refresh USB list finché l’unità non viene rilevata. | Assicurarsi che il file *.bnv si trovi nella cartella principale dell’unità USB. L’unità deve essere formattata in FAT32, lo standard comunemente utilizzato. |
| 5. | Premere Import settings. | ![BactoSense — Importazione ed esportazione USB](/img/gui/it/usb-import-and-export.png "width=263") |

| 6. | Selezionare le impostazioni da importare. Le impostazioni di misurazione includono gruppi di gate, impostazioni I/O, allarmi e impostazioni di data e ora. Le impostazioni di rete includono gli indirizzi IP, DNS e NTP. | ![BactoSense — Opzioni di importazione delle impostazioni](/img/gui/it/import-settings-options.png "width=269") |
| 7. | Premere Import settings e attendere il riavvio del dispositivo. |  |

old_steps: Le protocole NTP (Network Time Protocol) est un protocole réseau permettant de synchroniser l’heure des ordinateurs d’un réseau. Par défaut, la synchronisation s’effectue avec les serveurs de la Network Time Foundation (ntp.org). Vous pouvez définir des serveurs NTP personnalisés dans le menu *Date and Time* .
Sur l’écran d’accueil, appuyez sur Paramètres pour ouvrir le menu des paramètres.
Appuyez sur le bouton Paramètres système.
Appuyez sur le bouton Date & heure.
Appuyez sur le bouton Synchronisation du temps.
Sélectionnez la Source synchro souhaitée.
Appuyez sur le bouton OK.
Lorsque vous modifiez l’adresse d’un serveur et appuyez sur OK, le système envoie automatiquement une requête ping au serveur et actualise la date et l’heure.
new_steps: Le protocole NTP (Network Time Protocol) est un protocole réseau permettant de synchroniser l’heure des ordinateurs d’un réseau. Par défaut, la synchronisation s’effectue avec les serveurs de la Network Time Foundation (ntp.org). Vous pouvez définir des serveurs NTP personnalisés dans le menu *Date & heure* .
En tant qu’utilisateur Admin, sur l’écran d’accueil, appuyez sur Paramètres pour ouvrir le menu des paramètres.
Appuyez sur le bouton Paramètres système.
Appuyez sur le bouton Date & heure.
Appuyez sur le bouton Paramètres de synchronisation du temps.
Sélectionnez la Source synchro souhaitée.
Appuyez sur le bouton OK.
Appuyez sur Test NTP pour vérifier que les serveurs configurés sont accessibles. Appuyez sur OK pour enregistrer les paramètres de synchronisation.

old_steps: Demo mode can be used when demonstrating the device or when learning how to navigate  the menus and use the functions. When it is activated, the instrument reboots into a special  mode that displays demonstration data (the owner’s measurement results are hidden). All  the instrument’s functions are replaced by simulations that never move the hardware or  modify the results database. This means protocols can be started without needing to load a  sample, and users can pretend to delete or re-gate results without ever changing the data. If  the demo mode is activated, the message ***Demo*** is displayed in the upper middle of  the screen.  When the instrument is reverted to normal mode, the owner’s data is shown again, and all  functions are active again.
On the Home screen, press Settings to open the settings menu.
Enter the System settings button, and then the Demo mode button.
Select the Activate demo mode box.
Press the Save and restart button.
new_steps: Demo mode can be used when demonstrating the device or when learning how to navigate  the menus and use the functions. When it is activated, the instrument reboots into a special  mode that displays demonstration data (the owner’s measurement results are hidden). All  the instrument’s functions are replaced by simulations that never move the hardware or  modify the results database. This means protocols can be started without needing to load a  sample, and users can pretend to delete or re-gate results without ever changing the data. If  the demo mode is activated, the message ***Demo*** is displayed in the upper middle of  the screen.  When the instrument is reverted to normal mode, the owner’s data is shown again, and all  functions are active again.
As an Admin user, press Settings on the Home screen to open the settings menu.
Press the System settings button. Press the Demo mode button.
Select the Activate demo mode checkbox.
Press the Save and restart button.

old_steps: | 1 | Main result parameters, depending on cartridge type used. Find more information in [Cartridges, gates and result parameters](../results-and-data-analysis/#section-11-3). Tap the information icon beside the main result to display all result parameters (2). |

| 3 | Main dotplot in the result information window. The FL1 vs FL2 dotplot shows all detected events according to the amplitude of their fluorescence signals FL1 (535 nm, X-axis) and FL2 (715 nm, Y-axis). The red polygon and vertical line show the configured gate. For details refer to [Cartridges, gates and result parameters](../results-and-data-analysis/#section-11-3). Tap this dotplot preview to open a pop-up with access to all dotplots (4). |
| 5 | The optional warnings field indicates whether any warnings were generated during the measurement. Tap on the field to learn more. |
| 6 | The Delete button removes the measurement permanently (requires confirmation). |
| 7 | The Rename button can be used to change the measurement name. |
| 8 | The Re-Gate result button allows to apply a different gating to the measurement data. For details refer to [Regate measurements](../results-and-data-analysis/#section-11-4-1). |
| 9 | The Export button allows to save this result to a USB stick. More information can be found in [Export to a USB drive](../measurements/#section-10-8-1). |
| 10 | The navigation buttons on the left and right of the result view allow you to navigate to the previous and next measurements, respectively. |
Multiple selection & batch operations: In the list of measurements, long-press on one measurement to activate the selection of multiple measurements, then select Delete / Re-gate or Export.

old_steps: Navigate to the Home menu of the BactoSense user interface.
Press the Maintenance button.
Press the Self-check button.

Press the Run or Rerun button to start the self- check. Once execution has terminated, the instrument shows a list of all tests, with a green PASS or red FAIL indicator. Some tests may be skipped: if the system cannot communicate with the cartridge, all the tests that require cartridge communication are skipped.
new_steps: As an Advanced or Admin user, press Settings on the Home screen to open the settings menu.
Press the Maintenance button.
Press the Self-check button.

Press the Rerun button. Once execution has terminated, the instrument shows a list of all tests, with a green PASS or red FAIL indicator. Some tests may be skipped: if the system cannot communicate with the cartridge, all the tests that require cartridge communication are skipped.

old_steps: Navigieren Sie zur Startseite der Benutzeroberfläche des BactoSense.
Auf der Startseite der BactoSense Benutzeroberfläche, drücken Sie auf Wartung.
Drücken Sie die Taste Selbsttest.

Drücken Sie die Taste Start oder Neustart, um den Selbsttest zu starten. Sobald die Ausführung abgeschlossen wurde, zeigt das Gerät eine Liste aller Tests mit grünen PASS- oder roten FAIL-Anzeigen. Möglicherweise wurden einige Tests übersprungen: Kann das System mit der Kartusche nicht kommunizieren, werden alle Tests, die Kartuschenkommunikation erfordern, ausgelassen.
new_steps: Drücken Sie als Advanced- oder Admin-Benutzer auf der Startseite Einstellungen, um das Einstellungsmenü zu öffnen.
Drücken Sie die Taste Wartung.
Drücken Sie die Taste Selbstkontrolle.

Drücken Sie die Taste Wiederholen. Sobald die Ausführung abgeschlossen wurde, zeigt das Gerät eine Liste aller Tests mit grünen PASS- oder roten FAIL-Anzeigen. Möglicherweise wurden einige Tests übersprungen: Kann das System mit der Kartusche nicht kommunizieren, werden alle Tests, die Kartuschenkommunikation erfordern, ausgelassen.

old_steps: Accédez au Menu principal de l’interface utilisateur de BactoSense.
Appuyez sur le bouton Maintenance.
Appuyez sur le bouton Auto-contrôle.

Appuyez sur Run ou Rerun pour lancer l’autovérification. À la fin, l’instrument affiche la liste des tests avec un indicateur PASS vert ou FAIL rouge. Certains tests peuvent être ignorés : si le système ne peut pas communiquer avec la cartouche, tous les tests qui nécessitent cette communication sont ignorés.
new_steps: En tant qu’utilisateur Advanced ou Admin, sur l’écran d’accueil, appuyez sur Paramètres pour ouvrir le menu des paramètres.
Appuyez sur le bouton Maintenance.
Appuyez sur le bouton Autocontrôle.

Appuyez sur le bouton Relancer. À la fin, l’instrument affiche la liste des tests avec un indicateur PASS vert ou FAIL rouge. Certains tests peuvent être ignorés : si le système ne peut pas communiquer avec la cartouche, tous les tests qui nécessitent cette communication sont ignorés.
